recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-5211 unless a future PA decision changes the EpisodeOfCare.period element definition or the search parameter generation pipeline.
issue_request: FHIR-5211 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 PA ballot issue asking to clarify the EpisodeOfCare Search Parameters -> Date wording from the misleading inherited period text, "The interval during which the managing organization assumes the defined responsibility," to wording that the provided date search value falls within the episode of care's period.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-5211 was found. The 2015 EpisodeOfCare ballot reconciliation commit f659c3fbc1 added the requested search parameter text to the spreadsheet-era source while retaining the EpisodeOfCare.period element definition. The later source rewrite 33b409a4b6 carried the wording into source/episodeofcare/bundle-EpisodeOfCare-search-params.xml, and fede0a9351 only normalized XML apostrophe escaping while preserving the description.
additional_context: EpisodeOfCare is active in source/fhir.ini, and its current search parameters are represented in source/episodeofcare/bundle-EpisodeOfCare-search-params.xml. The older managing-organization phrase still appears on EpisodeOfCare.period itself and in diagram/mapping artifacts, but related ballot issues FHIR-5201 and FHIR-5208 support those element-level period semantics and are separate from FHIR-5211's search-parameter wording. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because SearchParameter/EpisodeOfCare-date already says, "The provided date search value falls within the episode of care's period." Editing EpisodeOfCare.period or generated-looking artifacts would exceed the Jira request and risk changing separate element semantics.

related_jiras.note: Same EpisodeOfCare ballot family requested explanatory guidance about managingOrganization and period coupling, supporting retention of the element-level period semantics outside FHIR-5211's search-parameter scope.
